# What contributors have built

**Nothing yet.** The inventory is published and the tooling works, but no campaign task has been completed and merged.

That is the honest state and this page will show it until it changes. A dashboard that reports activity — tasks published, people reached — rather than merged work is how a campaign persuades itself it is succeeding while producing nothing.

127 tasks are open now of 914 in the inventory. The rest are held back deliberately: releasing more work than can be reviewed leaves people waiting, which costs more than a shorter list does.

Reviewer load, queue age and incident details are deliberately **not** published here — those are about individuals, and aggregate output is what a reader needs.
